C1625.title: AI Deepfake Technology Exploited in Telecom Fraud and Kidnapping Extortion
C1625.summary: Deepfake technology can generate highly realistic fake videos and audio, which have been used by criminals in telecom fraud, kidnapping, and extortion schemes. Public security authorities have solved multiple such cases, highlighting the broad threat to personal safety and property.

references.title: Pathway Options for Criminal Regulation of AI 'Deepfakes'
